name: ISO/IEC 23894:2023 Information technology — Artificial intelligence — Guidance on risk management
description: ISO/IEC 23894:2023 is voluntary international guidance (not a certifiable requirements standard) that adapts the ISO 31000:2018 risk-management framework and process to AI, with Clause 4 principles, Clause 5 framework, Clause 6 process, and Annexes A (AI-related objectives), B (AI-related risk sources) and C (life-cycle mapping); it underpins the risk-treatment expectations of certifiable ISO/IEC 42001. Because it is guidance with high-level objectives rather than discrete shall-statements, most mappings are interpretive/partial: AKSI owns the agent-runtime slice of the risk PROCESS (identific
jurisdiction: International (ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42); voluntary guidance, not certifiable; basis for ISO/IEC 42001 risk treatment
regime_version: 2023 (first edition, published 2023-02; adopted in Europe as EN ISO/IEC 23894:2024)
